cue: The princess is alone in a room with a locked door. She seems to be trying to talk.

text: Thank you hero! When I found out I would be voiceless until someone broke the silence, I didn't think that this is what they meant. I was trapped here by an evil witch when I criticized her artwork. To be fair it was really awful. Anyways, time to rescue me. Draw your sword!
Hmm, I know the hero is supposed to draw a sword to save me. But that doesn't seem to be working. What else could you try?
Well that wasn't what I had in mind but it worked! Now we need to get the key out of that box. You can probably smash it on the floor.

cue: The princess looks thoughtful, considering how to free the key.
text: Oh yeah I forgot, that is special sword-proof rope. Can't cut it. I wonder if this will work... we need something to catch fire!
Wow that actually worked. I like this game.
Okay, now get that key into the picture.
I was worried about that. But we need that key in the picture.

cue: The princess bends down and picks up a key, uses it to open the locked door, and walks outside the castle.
